meaning:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.15.18
§ Unni = "afflicted"
1) a Levite doorkeeper in the time of David
2) a Levite concerned in the sacred office after the return from exile in Babylon

elsewhere.note: and with them their brothers of the second rank, Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu…
Also Bakbukiah and Unno, their brothers, were close to them according to their offices.
